reason: The configured executable completed the interface probe through the native job runner.
stdout_tail:
--verbose VERBOSE     Set to positive for more verbose printout.
                        0 = Default print level.     1 = Basic info about optimization step.
                        2 = Include microiterations. 3 = Lots of printout from low-level functions.
                         
  --qdata QDATA         Provide "yes" to write qdata.txt containing coordinates, energies, gradients for each structure.
                         
  --logINI LOGINI       .ini file for customizing logging output.
                         
  --write_cart_hess WRITE_CART_HESS
                        Write approximate cartesian Hessian at optimized geometry to specified file.
                         

software:
  Options specific for certain software packages

  --molproexe MOLPROEXE
                        Specify absolute path of Molpro executable.
                         
  --molcnv MOLCNV       Provide "yes" to use Molpro style convergence criteria instead of the default.
                         
  --qcdir QCDIR         Provide an initial Q-Chem scratch folder (e.g. supplied initial guess).
                         
  --qccnv QCCNV         Provide "yes" to Use Q-Chem style convergence criteria instead of the default.
                         
  --bagelexe BAGELEXE   Specify how to run Bagel, e.g. "mpirun -np 4 BAGEL".
                         
  --ase-class ASE_CLASS
                        ASE calculator import path, eg. "ase.calculators.lj.LennardJones"
  --ase-kwargs ASE_KWARGS
                        ASE calculator keyword args, as JSON dictionary, eg. {"param_filename":"path/to/file.xml"}

debug:
  Relevant for development and debugging

  --displace DISPLACE   Provide "yes" to write out displacements of the internal coordinates.
                         
  --fdcheck FDCHECK     Provide "yes" to check internal coordinate gradients using finite difference.
                         

help:
  Get help

  -h, --help            Show this help message and exit
